scope: Exploratory native auto-trace reconstruction; not original controlled redraw or rig.
findings: All three character PNGs remain rectangular poster crops with sky, city, other characters and energy included. Mask creation did not isolate characters.

Native files parse with true vector paths. Trace layers contain 159228/117730/115579 direct children for center/elder/right; no meaningful independent body, face, eyelid, mouth or hand controls shown.
Hidden locked embedded original reference layers exist in all three native files. Source reference is preserved, but visible exports remain traced poster content.

Detailed trace preserves source composition and major facial landmarks but introduces speckle, stepped shading and fine-edge changes. Simplified trace severely degrades faces and detail; retain as rejected.
Poster occlusions, crossing energy, cropped bodies and missing hidden anatomy preclude clean rigging without new drawing.
Large anonymous path counts provide low-level editability but do not establish practical production control; no interactive performance or motion test performed by reviewer.
next: Await corrected masked candidates for delta inspection; prior rejection retained. No claim of clean redraw, rig or task completion.
